---

设 $x=t^2+t$，$y=t^3+t$，求
$$
\left.\frac{d^2x}{dy^2}\right|_{t=0}.
$$

<!-- answer -->

因 $dy/dt=3t^2+1>0$，
$$
\frac{dx}{dy}=\frac{2t+1}{3t^2+1},\qquad
\frac{d^2x}{dy^2}=\frac1{3t^2+1}\frac d{dt}\left(\frac{2t+1}{3t^2+1}\right)
=\frac{2(3t^2+1)-6t(2t+1)}{(3t^2+1)^3}.
$$
代入 $t=0$，得 $\boxed{2}$。
